Full recipe! It’s so incredibly easy and quick. 

•  300 g ground beef (or half beef / half lamb)
•  1 onion, chopped
•  3 garlic clove, minced
•  150 g tomato purée or crushed tomatoes
•  3 tsp tomato concentrate (paste)
•  1 pinch of nutmeg (optional)
• 3 tablespoons of each oregano and paprika 
Fresh parsley 🌿 added before finishing 

For the béchamel:
•   3 tablespoons butter
•  2.5 tablespoons flour
•  2 cups of milk
a dash of nutmeg, garlic powder and s&p (optional but recommended) 


Layer and bake at 350 for 30 minutes! 

This used 3 large russet potatoes, 2 cups of shredded cheese. 

Cut the potatoes into slices about 0.5 cm thick.
Spread them on a baking sheet, brush with olive oil and bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes until golden brown. 

Layer and bake at 350 for 30 minutes! #healthyrecipes #dinnerideas #easydinner #momof3 #familytime #outdoorkids
